answer: Picture agents as corals on a reef, each anchored by a bond whose funds must trace, hop by hop, to a distinct independently-earned origin. Every transfer is signed into a provenance cipher a rotating jury can replay; clones fed from one treasury share a lineage root and, like identical pigment drawn from one pot, stain the same color and are flagged and slashed. Faking N agents forces an attacker to originate N genuinely separate capital streams, so sybil cost grows linearly as N times real economic provenance.
